'''Fanny Esther Uribe López''' (born 1963) is an Ecuadorian biologist and politician who was the last person to be elected prefect of the [[Galápagos Province|Galápagos]].

==Biography==
Uribe began her political career in 1996 as an alternate deputy of the [[Galápagos Province]] for the [[Christian Democratic Union (Ecuador)|Popular Democracy]] party.<ref name="primera">{{cite web | url= http://www.eluniverso.com/2004/11/01/0001/8/A807BD045E1642FBB0B804DA278C56ED.html | title= Las mujeres ganaron el 4,65% de las alcaldías | accessdate= 1 January 2017 | date= 1 November 2004 | work= [[El Universo]] | language= Spanish| archiveurl= https://web.archive.org/web/20160424135457/http://www.eluniverso.com/2004/11/01/0001/8/A807BD045E1642FBB0B804DA278C56ED.html | archivedate= 24 April 2016 }}</ref> In the [[1998 Ecuadorian general election|1998 legislative elections]], she was elected national deputy of Galápagos by the same party.<ref>{{cite web | url= http://www.explored.com.ec/noticias-ecuador/mayoria-dp-psc-en-congreso-96326.html | title= Mayoría DP-PSC en el Congreso | accessdate= 9 December 2016 | date= 11 June 1998 | work= Hoy | language=Spanish | archiveurl= https://web.archive.org/web/20150407163931/http://www.explored.com.ec/noticias-ecuador/mayoria-dp-psc-en-congreso-96326.html | archivedate= 7 April 2015 }}</ref> From the National Congress, she was one of the promoters of the Special Law of Conservation and Sustainable Development for the province of Galápagos.<ref name="primera" />

In the 2004 local elections, Uribe was elected provincial prefect of Galápagos with 54% of the votes by the alliance between the Popular Democracy, the [[Patriotic Society Party|21 January Patriotic Society Party]] and the [[Socialist Party – Broad Front of Ecuador|Socialist Party-Broad Front]],<ref>Informe del Consejo Nacional Electoral. ''[https://web.archive.org/web/20160406004534/https://app.cne.gob.ec/Resultados2004/Result_PDF/Pref/2_20.pdf Resultados elecciones seccionales 2004.]'' Consultado el 9 de diciembre de 2016.</ref> becoming the first woman to hold that position.<ref name="primera" /> The entry into force of the [[2008 Constitution of Ecuador|2008 constitution]] eliminated the Galápagos provincial council, thus also making her the last person to be elected to the province's prefecture.<ref>{{cite web | url= http://www.eluniverso.com/2008/12/14/1/1355/46F8F26EAAD74265858C5352B84DFD59.html | title= En región Insular vigencia de Carta Magna causa confusión | accessdate= 9 December 2016 | date= 14 December 2008 | work= [[El Universo]] | language= Spanish | archiveurl= https://web.archive.org/web/20160408060858/http://www.eluniverso.com/2008/12/14/1/1355/46F8F26EAAD74265858C5352B84DFD59.html | archivedate= 8 April 2016 }}</ref> She resigned from her position to participate in the 2009 local elections as a candidate for mayor of [[Santa Cruz Canton, Ecuador|Santa Cruz]] for the Municipalist Movement,<ref>{{cite web | url= http://eluniverso.com/2009/04/19/1/1447/36371964053A4EABB507D5F1F9FFBC55.html | title= Proceso de transición estancado en región insular de Galápagos | accessdate= 9 December 2016 | last= Barona | first= Jorge | date= 9 April 2009 | work= [[El Universo]] | language= Spanish | archiveurl= https://web.archive.org/web/20090422165524/http://eluniverso.com/2009/04/19/1/1447/36371964053A4EABB507D5F1F9FFBC55.html | archivedate= 22 April 2009 }}</ref> but she was not elected.<ref>{{cite web | url= http://www.elcomercio.com/actualidad/politica/mapa-regional-se-hizo-verde.html | title= El mapa regional se hizo verde el domingo | accessdate= 9 December 2016| date= 20 February 2013 | work= El Comercio | language= Spanish | archiveurl= https://web.archive.org/web/20161025184055/http://www.elcomercio.com/actualidad/politica/mapa-regional-se-hizo-verde.html | archivedate= 25 October 2016 }}</ref>

In the [[2013 Ecuadorian general election|2013 legislative elections]], Uribe was elected to the [[National Assembly (Ecuador)|National Assembly]] representing [[Avanza (political party)|Avanza]] in the Galápagos constituency.<ref>{{cite web | url= http://www.ecuavisa.com/articulo/noticias/actualidad/30577-asambleistas-para-el-periodo-2013-2017 | title= Asambleístas para el período 2013-2017 | accessdate= 9 December 2016 | date= 14 May 2013 | work= [[Ecuavisa]] | language= Spanish | archiveurl= https://web.archive.org/web/20130615052828/http://www.ecuavisa.com/articulo/noticias/actualidad/30577-asambleistas-para-el-periodo-2013-2017 | archivedate= 15 June 2013 }}</ref>
